facts.fact: Leaders of the Sindicato dos Jornalistas Angolanos, the Comissao de Carteira e Etica and the Forum das Mulheres Jornalistas called the penalties of the new Law Against False Information on the Internet excessive and inhibiting, warning of a chilling effect on free debate; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.
